title: Rank/quantile decision rule (deterministic, prior-free) on the adapted score
protocol: global (within-regime) quantile: reject lowest q, accept highest q, review middle -> review% on 1,546 = 1-2q exactly. within-factory quantile: per-factory rank-fraction u=(rank+0.5)/n in [q,1-q] reviewed; 1,546 review% computed exactly from the E8 per-factory counts. OOD BA on decided windows of the 160, factory-grouped 2000x CI.
